title: Four Card Poker
betGuide: Place ante and optional Aces Up side bet
betError: Ante must be at least 10, bets in steps of 10, and within your balance

tutorial.betControls: Set ante and optional Aces Up bet, then press Bet.
tutorial.actionButtons: Pick a play multiplier (1x-3x) and press Play, or Fold.
tutorial.results: Compare best 4-card hands and review payouts.

frontendHint.fourcardpokerBet: Place an ante to be dealt in
frontendHint.fourcardpokerPlayMax: Three of a kind or better — bet the maximum
frontendHint.fourcardpokerPlayMin: A middling hand — bet the minimum
frontendHint.fourcardpokerFold: No better than a pair, and the dealer gets an extra card — fold
